name: Ace Smith

lean.basis: Democratic political consultant for California Democrats including Harris and Newsom.

race_2028.basis: Longtime strategist to both Newsom and Harris through Bearstar Strategies.

summary: Ace Smith is a founding partner of the California consulting firm Bearstar Strategies, whose campaigns elected Kamala Harris attorney general and senator and Gavin Newsom lieutenant governor and governor; the firm also ran paid media for Newsom's Proposition 50.

connections.name: Gavin Newsom
connections.description: Smith and his Bearstar partners ran Newsom's races for lieutenant governor and governor.

connections.description: Smith and his Bearstar partners ran the races that elected Harris California attorney general and senator.
